message.content: This editorial illustration depicts a man boxing a hanging sack against a flat orange-red background. The man occupies the left side, shown from the waist up in profile, facing right. He has dark hair, light skin rendered with cross-hatching, and wears a light-colored, short-sleeved shirt and red boxing gloves. He is captured in motion, leaning forward with his right glove making contact with the middle of the sack. The sack, which resembles a large bag of grain or sand, hangs vertically from a metal chain and hook on the right. It is a pale color with horizontal stitched patterns and is depicted vibrating from the impact. Large, bold black text across the bottom reads "GERABAK-GERUBUK POLITIK BERAS". Above it, smaller white text says "LIPUTAN KHUSUS DAERAH LAYAK INVESTASI" and "LIKA-LIKU MENANGKAP KAPAL SABU-SABU". Below the main title is smaller orange text describing business competition and PT Indo Beras Unggul. A barcode and "31 JULI - 6 AGUSTUS 2017" appear in the bottom left. The word "TEMPO" is partially visible in large, faded red letters behind the man.
